# Temple Scroll Column 49 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 49 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**49:1** When you besiege a city many days to wage war against it to capture it, you shall not destroy its trees by wielding an axe against them.

**49:2** For you may eat from them, and you shall not cut them down; for is a tree of the field a man, that it should be besieged by you?

**49:3** Only the tree that you know is not a tree for food — it you may destroy and cut down, and you shall build siege works against the city.

**49:4** You shall have a peg among your tools, and when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it and turn back and cover your excrement.

**49:5** For the LORD your God walks in the midst of your camp to deliver you and to give your enemies before you; and your camp shall be holy, so that he may not see any indecent thing among you and turn away from you.

**49:6** When you go out to war against your enemies and the LORD your God gives them into your hand, and you take them captive —

**49:7** and you see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you desire her and would take her as your wife —

**49:8** then you shall bring her into your house, and she shall shave her head and trim her nails.

**49:9** She shall put off her garment of captivity and shall remain in your house and weep for her father and her mother a full month.

**49:10** And after that you may go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

**49:11** If it happens that you do not delight in her, you shall send her away wherever she wishes; but you shall not sell her for money.

**49:12** You shall not treat her as a slave, because you have humbled her.

**49:13** You shall not deliver to his master a slave who has escaped from his master to you.

**49:14** He shall dwell with you, in your midst, in the place that he shall choose within one of your gates, wherever it is good for him; you shall not oppress him.

**49:15** There shall be no consecrated woman among the daughters of Israel, and there shall be no consecrated man among the sons of Israel.

**49:16** You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute or the price of a dog into the house of the LORD your God for any vow, for both of them are a detestable thing to the LORD your God.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows EMET throughout. "Consecrated woman/man" retained for qedeshah/qadesh (v. 15) per project convention established in Genesis 38 — avoids the anachronistic "cult prostitute" and LOGOS's "cult devotee." "Price of a dog" preserved as the traditional euphemism (v. 16) rather than LOGOS's explicit interpretation. "Humbled" retained over PNEUMA's "taken her dignity" for innah. "Weep" preferred over LOGOS's "mourn" for bakah — the verb specifically denotes weeping.*
